lines.text: Many learners say: I think, that you are right.
Better: I think that you are right.
Write that right after think, with nothing between.
The second one! I think that you are right.

native.tip: Im Deutschen steht vor „dass“ ein Komma. Im Englischen schreiben Sie „I think that“ ohne Komma.
native.caption: Setzen Sie ein Komma vor „that“? ✍️ Falsch: “I think, that you are right.” Richtig: “I think that you are right.” Hören Sie Carlos zu und sprechen Sie nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.

en.tip: German uses a comma before “dass.” In English you write “I think that” without a comma.
en.caption: No comma before “that”! Wrong: “I think, that you are right.” Right: “I think that you are right.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
